hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"`
aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv Managed_Inputs.csv unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-0c2e7d88-731d-4e37-9af3-435c54e71610' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='harmonizeddb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="dccharmonized"
echo "testing connection to db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
echo "Establishing necessary schemas" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "ALTER DATABASE $DB set client_min_messages=warning" \ -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS hpds_mappings" \ -c "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS hpds_mappings.merged_mappings" \ -c "CREATE TABLE hpds_mappings.merged_mappings (dbgap_id numeric, phs text, hpds_id numeric)"
echo "fetching applicable study/version list for dcc" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY (SELECT distinct phs from util.study_versions) to study_versions.csv WITH (FORMAT CSV, HEADER TRUE)"
IFS=',' while read phs; do
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 900 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=`grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=`grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=`grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g"` if [[ $phs == 'phs000289' ]] || [[ $phs == 'phs001402' ]]; then echo "$phs belongs to mayovte, which has a non-compatible consent issue. skipping"
elif [[ ! -z `grep $phs Managed_Inputs.csv` ]]; then echo "$phs present in managed_inputs, fetching patient mapping" export query="select \"Study Abbreviated Name\" from Managed_Inputs where \"Study Identifier\" = '$phs'" echo $query abv=`csvsql --query $query Managed_Inputs.csv | csvformat -E` echo "abv is $abv" mkdir $abv aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv,,}/data/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv $abv sed -i "s/${abv^^}/${phs}/g" $abv/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -c "\COPY hpds_mappings.merged_mappings from '$abv/${abv^^}_PatientMapping.v2.csv' WITH (FORMAT CSV)"
else echo "$phs not ingested by picsure. skipping" fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
done < study_versions.csv
